subject: reasoning
question: Kiran starts from Point A and drives 5 km towards south. He then takes a left turn, drives 7 km, turns left and drives 8 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 9 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Kiran starts from Point A and drives 5 km towards south.

He then takes a left turn, drives 7 km, turns left and drives 8 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 9 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d437010a131321cc9f677c0a63e7b62f0ece881d85767b8cfb16190e488f609e.png] 

So, He should drive **2 km to east ** in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
